Why_this_title: 2,291 creatives / 6,939 ad plans observed in one recent month, 66 market targets and high video share.
What_to_learn: Build a reusable creative grammar and localization factory rather than one-off assets.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not treat observed plan coverage as budget share or creative quality.

Why_this_title: Current store promise allows lucky players to redeem real bouquets.
What_to_learn: Use a physical reward as a differentiated CRM/PR hook when the fantasy naturally supports it.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not launch without geo eligibility, fulfillment cost, fraud and customer-support controls.

Why_this_title: Friend garden visits, assistance and flower interactions are connected to collection/progression.
What_to_learn: Make visits produce useful but bounded resource/relationship value.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not let stealing or premium flower access make social competition feel predatory.

Why_this_title: Current reviews complain premium flowers can score disproportionately in guild/event tasks.
What_to_learn: Audit competitive scoring by F2P/payer inventory and expected task completion.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not sell direct leaderboard power without a fairness/segmentation model.

Why_this_title: 25 visible iOS releases May18→Sep25; median 5.0d gap.
What_to_learn: Use small frequent fixes/content drops if release/QA/localization automation can support it.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not confuse high client frequency with high feature velocity or low QA cost.

Why_this_title: Official payment center plus near-weekly gift-code cadence and current Discord/community rewards.
What_to_learn: Use low-asset CRM and D2C as a retention/payer layer between content drops.
What_NOT_to_copy: Do not infer D2C effectiveness without payer overlap/claim/return telemetry.
